description: This file provides formatting and theming utility functions for command models, including colorization, padding, key-value formatting, and tag styling, primarily for terminal output.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines whether the terminal output supports rich formatting, based on terminal capabilities and options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length using end padding.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string based on theme and richness.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string based on theme and richness.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional colorization.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Creates a styled separator string for terminal output.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Styles a tag string based on its type and richness.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Shortens a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if truncated.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
